Ava (Docs): Quick heads-up — we need a final QA pass on the changelog for the deploy tomorrow. I want a focused checklist: snippet verification, link sweep, known-issue callouts, and a short rollback blurb. :eyes:
Tom (Eng): OK, I can run through the SDK snippets and verify live outputs. I'll post diffs if anything diverges from examples.
Priya (PM): Please make sure the feature announcement copy clarifies the new routing policy change and the expected perf numbers. PM wants a single sentence callout for customers.
Marco (SDK): Working on running the Python/Go examples. Small note: the streaming example needs the new client flag --enable-stream-fallback in the snippet or it breaks on older runtimes.
Ava (Docs): Good catch. Marco, can you paste the exact snippet change you recommend?
Marco (SDK): Sure — change the streaming snippet from:```python
client.generate_stream(prompt)
```to:```python
client.generate_stream(prompt, enable_stream_fallback=True)
```
Ava (Docs): Thanks. I'll update the code block and add a short "compatibility" note below it.
docs-ci: build passed for branch release/changelog-2026-03 (checks: lint, linkcheck, snippet-tests) :white_check_mark:
Tom (Eng): Linkcheck failed earlier on a redirect to /v1/embeddings — apparently the old anchor still exists in the site map. I patched the redirect in staging but we should update the canonical link in the SDK snippets.
Ava (Docs): Which page exactly?
Tom (Eng): docs/models/embeddings.md — bottom example uses /v1/embeddings?model=embed-xyz, needs to be /api/embeddings as per new router.
Ava (Docs): I'll update that anchor. Add to checklist: update embeddings example link.
Priya (PM): From product: add a known-issue about memory spikes on long-history chat sessions with quantized models. It's intermittent but we should warn customers and link to the mitigation steps (set max_history_tokens).
Ava (Docs): Noted. I'll draft the known-issue blurb: "Intermittent memory spikes may occur on long-history chat sessions when using quantized model variants. Mitigation: set max_history_tokens=1024 or use model-variant 'full-kv' for heavy context workloads." Review?
Tom (Eng): Fine by me. Can we also add a rollout/rollback line: if customers see >10% tail latency regressions after upgrade, switch routing policy to legacy-prefetch and open a support ticket with the trace id.
Priya (PM): PM-approved. Keep the rollback instructions short and link to ops runbook.
Ava (Docs): I'll add a 1-paragraph rollback under "If you see issues" with a link to /ops/runbooks/changelog-rollback and the support contact.
Marco (SDK): One more snippet note — Go example uses old import path "github.com/redwood/sdk"; new path is "github.com/redwood/inference-go/sdk". Tests flagged that.
Ava (Docs): Great — will update the imports.
docs-ci: snippet-tests failed on branch release/changelog-2026-03 (Go snippets): see /ci/logs/3332104302/snippet-go-fail.txt
Tom (Eng): I'll re-run snippet test locally and push a fix.
Ava (Docs): Timeline: can we have all snippet fixes + link updates by EOD? I want to ship a unified changelog with the release notes.
Tom (Eng): Yes. I'll have the Go fix up in 45m.
Marco (SDK): Python/Node tests all green. I'll open a tiny PR for the streaming flag + import path right now.
Priya (PM): For the announcement blurb: 1) 20% latency improvement on p95 for small tokens, 2) known issue about quantized memory spikes, 3) rollback line. Keep it under 3 bullets.
Ava (Docs): Drafting the announce blurb now and adding to /docs/changelog/2026-03-15.md. Will ping for a quick sign-off before merge.
Tom (Eng): PR 4123 pushed with Go fix. CI passing locally, waiting for docs-ci.
docs-ci: build passed for branch release/changelog-2026-03 (checks: lint, linkcheck, snippet-tests) :white_check_mark:
Ava (Docs): Final checklist for merge: 1) update streaming snippet (Marco) 2) fix Go import (Tom) 3) update embeddings link (Ava) 4) add known-issue blurb (Ava) 5) add rollback runbook link (Ava) 6) sign-off from Priya.
Priya (PM): Sign-off from PM for copy and rollback wording. :rocket:
Ava (Docs): Thanks — merging after docs-ci green. If anything else pops up, @channel but otherwise I'll cut the release notes at 16:00 UTC and notify marketing.
Marco (SDK): Quick FYI — I updated the node snippet to include a short comment about client options. Small PR: 4126.
Tom (Eng): All merged, changelog published to staging. I'll monitor traces for tail latency after deploy.
Ava (Docs): Great work team. I'll follow up with the marketing one-liner and an internal note linking to the changelog + runbook. :tada:
